title: Shooting modes
summary: Who sets what: you or the camera.

blocks.text: Scene modes (portrait, landscape, sport, night) are presets of the same three settings. Av or Tv usually gives more predictable results.

items: Set **aperture** for how much you want in focus.
Turn the **shutter** until the meter reads 0.
Check the photo. Too dark? Aim the meter at +. Too bright? Aim at −.
